# Test fixtures

* `mock_notary_seed.hex`: public 32-byte test seed for v3 BabyJubjub EdDSA-Poseidon.
  Anyone can sign with it. Never authorize its key in a production whitelist.
* `eddsa_v3.json`: independent circomlibjs 0.1.7 signature/hash vector, generated by
  `node circuits/scripts/test.mjs --write-vector`. Rust must reproduce every value.
* `circom_v3_proof_fixture.json`: full v3 circuit VK/proof, verified through the
  Solana program's native pairing code. Local test ceremony only; never deploy this VK.
* `dev_proof_fixture.json`: legacy DEV-circuit VK/proof used by native program tests.
  It proves range/commitment/nullifier only; it is not the v3 signature circuit.

The obsolete RSA signing fixtures were removed in v3. RSA arithmetic tests in
`triad-core` remain independent of the attestation protocol.
